data.landed_dir_note: the build directory sat outside the skill tree, so only its name is recorded: an absolute path here is not reproducible on another machine. The authoritative provenance is source_payloads (source payload file names) plus the per-contract windows below.

accuracy.sample_size_note: perfect per-field rates on 26 samples give a 95% lower bound of about 0.8677; 40+ samples are needed before an exact-match rate reads as evidence rather than as absence of counter-examples

skips.reason: entry condition never triggered within available bars

metrics.sharpe_basis: per-trade mean/sd scaled by sqrt(trades_per_year), trades_per_year = 244 / mean(held_bars=5.17)

replay_equivalence.what_this_is: daily bar replay (close-to-close with next-open fills)
what_this_is_not: a futures simulation contest / matching engine
replay_equivalence.why_equivalent: the rule set is declared in trading-day horizons and daily-close triggers, so a daily replay resolves every decision point the rules can express
where_it_breaks: rules that depend on intraday touch order
limit-locked sessions where no fill is possible
portfolio-level capital allocation across simultaneous rules
roll gaps from unadjusted dominant stitching

in_scope: daily-close rules on I, RB over 20240102..20240628
bars strictly after each opinion's published_at
out_of_scope: intraday entries, limit-order fills, auction mechanics
products outside the declared symbol list
roll adjustment (unadjusted dominant stitching is used)
fails_when: a rule has no numeric level and no explicit direction
bars are missing for a declared symbol
